title: Grilled Flaky Fish with Indian-Style Spices
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Italian-inspired dish that combines the delicate taste of flaky fish with the bold spices of India. Perfect for a light and refreshing lunch.

ingredients.name: Flaky Fish (such as Cod or Tilapia)
Indian-Style Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt, pepper, and Indian-Style Spice Blend.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the fish for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix together lemon juice, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Brush the lemon-ginger mixture onto the cooked fish during the last minute of grilling.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
